title: Week 1 · Day 1 · Upper A · Mon 14 Sep

rir_info.title: Reps in reserve
rir_info.body: This week's target is 3 RIR: stop each set with 3 reps left in the tank.

set_type_choices.label: Myorep (M)
set_type_choices.note: Rest 5 to 15 seconds between mini-sets, and log the total reps.

set_type_choices.label: Myorep match (MM)
set_type_choices.note: Do as many mini-sets as you need to match the first set's reps.

help.title: Resting by feel
help.body: There is no rest timer. Rest until your breathing is back to normal, you feel mentally ready, no supporting muscle is cramping, and you can hit at least 3 to 5 reps. That is usually 30 seconds to 5 minutes. Paired exercises go back to back: note it on the exercise or reorder them.

help.title: Warm-ups
help.body: 12 reps at a weight you could lift 30 or more times. 8 reps at a weight you could lift about 20 times. 4 reps at about your 10-rep max. Then your working sets, at 3 RIR. Warm-up sets are not logged.

help.title: Dumbbells and one side at a time
help.body: For dumbbells, enter the weight of one dumbbell. For exercises done one side at a time, start with your weaker side, match its reps on the other side, and log one side's reps.

help.title: Deload week
help.body: The deload is meant to feel easy. Push the 0 RIR week as hard as possible before it.

help.title: Training while sick
help.body: Feeling unwell? Train lighter or skip the session. A missed workout costs less than a sick week.

help.title: Training alongside a sport
help.body: Training alongside a sport? Tell the app your sport days in your schedule, and expect to take sets off the muscles the sport hits hard.

help.title: Long workouts
help.body: Sessions running long? Answer "Pushed my limits" honestly in the feedback, or lower the priority of a muscle. Both cut the sets the app plans.

swap_advice: Swap an exercise only for a good reason, such as pain or equipment you can't use. Changing exercises often makes your progress harder to see.
